messages:
alex: Quick question — proposal for SA claim fallthrough / circuit-breaker behavior when quota checks fail at edge. thinking we should have a soft-fail first with telemetry + UI notice before hard deny. cc @maria :thinking:

maria: can you sketch flows? hard to reason in my head.

alex: Flow A: request arrives -> auth proxy checks SA claims -> quota judge -> if quota unknown -> route to backup project (if bound) else soft-allow + attach "quota_unknown" signal. send telemetry event "auth.flow.quota_unknown". log sample:
```
auth.check {
  sa: "svc-analytics"
  quota_status: "unknown"
  fallback: "soft_allow"
}
```

jonah: soft-allow seems risky — product teams will hit runaway costs. how do we prevent billing surprises?

alex: agreed. Proposal includes rate-limited soft-allow (token-bucket ramp for unknown quota), and UI flag "billing-risk" shown in console for last-24h traffic. auto-breaker to hard-deny after threshold (e.g., 1000 reqs or $50) with notification.

priya: from UX: console needs a per-SA timeline and per-route badge. Should be able to flip fallback policy (soft/hard) per-project. also need rollout controls.

maria: telemetry: need a clear dimension to count "soft_allow" vs "hard_deny" and "fallback_project". Also ensure we tag original org/project for attribution.

jonah: technical: where to implement? auth-proxy or gate service? mixing at proxy adds latency but central gate loses edge locality.

alex: think implement in gateway (edge) so we can short-circuit latency. Use a sync call to central quota-cache with eventual consistency. Circuit-breaker state maintained in gateway with periodic refresh.

infra-bot: Deploy note: gateway circuit-breaker state requires new Redis key schema: rb:circuit:<gateway_id>:<sa_id> -> JSON blob TTL 5m. Rollout: canary 1%, then 10%, 50%.

priya: console change request: add "Fallback policy" toggle in SA detail panel + "Billing risk" chart. Also add alerting webhook when auto-breaker trips.

maria: ok. action items: alex to write design doc, jonah to prototype gateway cache, priya to mock console UI, infra to plan key migration. anyone else?

jonah: I can start prototype tomorrow. One more: need to define metrics names and units.

alex: proposing:
- auth.quota.soft_allow.count
- auth.quota.hard_deny.count
- auth.quota.fallback_project.count
- auth.quota.auto_breaker.cost_estimated_usd
add tag: org_id, project_id, sa_id, route

priya: +1. I'll use those for dashboard. let's keep alerts on cost_estimated_usd > 50 in 1h.

maria: thanks. alex, please create doc and add to #docs channel when ready.
